subject: Jessica Eisenman Parks Candidate Profile
overview: School Committee candidate Jessica Eisenman Parks presented her platform, emphasizing strategic budgeting, expanded after-school programming, and support for diverse learners.

items.title: Candidate background and motivation
items.summary: Jessica Parks discussed her transition from a parent advocate during the "Invest in Medford" override campaign to a candidate for School Committee.

items.title: After-school program expansion
items.summary: Parks described her work with parent groups and administration to expand after-school spots by analyzing case studies from neighboring districts.

items.title: Budgeting and fiscal strategy
items.summary: The candidate proposed a strategic budgeting approach that identifies the full cost of educational goals and pursues alternative funding sources for shortfalls.

items.title: Support for diverse learners
items.summary: Parks advocated for improved classroom resources and professional development to ensure all students, including those with IEPs or advanced needs, remain engaged in the district.

items.title: Communication and community engagement
items.summary: The candidate pledged to increase transparency and trust through regular community office hours and dedicated engagement sessions for staff and students.
